Experimental score notice: Experimental relative susceptibility score for research demonstration. It is not a calibrated probability or an official warning. Local conditions and independent validation are not represented.
V2 comparison notice: V2 performed worse than V1 on matched spatial evaluation. Rainfall inputs are 1970–2000 climate normals; terrain is approximately 1 km. WorldClim is for academic/non-commercial use; redistribution or commercial use requires permission.
Environmental feature guidance: Supply environmental values from the documented layers for this location and record their source. Coordinates and live sensor/weather readings are not model inputs.
Example assessment notice: These supplied example inputs are not extracted from a selected location. Example runs are not saved as real assessments.
Evaluation comparison notice: Reported out-of-fold results: 179 fatal-event records and 179 unknown-background samples, matched spatial folds. Higher precision alone does not establish suitability. Scores are not directly interchangeable or calibrated probabilities; no independent validation is supplied.
Extraction pending notice: Coordinate assessment requires prepared local environmental datasets. It does not predict an imminent landslide.
Confirm association notice: Choose a monitoring location below and explicitly confirm its association with this report. No location is guessed from proximity.
Dispatch separation notice: Review the report and assign a team here. Model assessment and monitoring-location setup are not required.
Duplicate review notice: Same incident category within 500 metres and 24 hours: review before assigning another team. Reports are not merged automatically.
Destination confirmation notice: Confirm the pin against the location description. Click the map or edit coordinates to correct it; corrections require a reason. The bundled reference map is not street navigation.
No teams configured: No teams configured. You can verify without dispatch; use team setup to register a team.
All teams busy: All teams are busy. Verification can proceed without dispatch.
Outside configured team coverage: No available team covers this destination under its configured bounds.
Coverage confirmation notice: Teams without configured coverage have unknown coverage. Confirm the selected team can attend this destination.
Assignment progress notice: Assigned means reserved, not travelling. Only officials or administrators may confirm departure, arrival and completion.
Emergency contact notice: Submitting a report does not automatically contact emergency services.
Inline team setup notice: Enter a team you are authorised to register. Registration records the team; it does not contact or dispatch anyone. Coverage remains unconfigured and must be confirmed before assignment.
Coordinate assessment guidance: Select coordinates in North East India. Extract local environmental layers, inspect their provenance, then explicitly run the selected model.
Extracted input review notice: These values were sampled from local source grids. Check units, source dates, resolution and missing values before scoring.
Model imputation guidance: V1 requires every field. V2 can impute missing continuous pixels using its saved pipeline; WorldCover must be a represented category. Missing files are not treated as missing pixels.
Training unit convention notice: Units and conversions follow the supplied training convention. SOC is passed unchanged; its physical stock/concentration interpretation still needs independent source confirmation.
Incomplete environmental assessment: Required inputs are missing or invalid here. No score will be generated.
Map assessment selection guidance: Officials: click the map, then open the environmental-input inspection link. This does not run a model or publish a warning.
No saved locations to select on map: No saved locations to select on map. Create a monitoring location first.
Saved location map guidance: Click a saved location marker, then confirm. This selects that record; it does not create a location or choose the nearest record.
Coordinate map guidance: Click to place a pin, then use the selected coordinates. Enter the location description separately. Map selection does not provide measured GPS accuracy.
